owns: typed notification event and request-payload construction
dispatch endpoint and internal-auth header resolution
raw response decoding and dispatched-channel response validation
event-specific default messages and non-blocking dispatch outcome formatting
invariants: chain-started maps to the chain_started notification type rather than chain_complete
dispatch endpoint precedence honors an explicit endpoint, then MENTIKO_DISPATCH_ENDPOINT, BETTER_AUTH_URL, MENTIKO_WEB_URL, and the localhost port fallback
the dispatch route validates raw JSON and normalized event/string fields before side effects
